basic_info.description: Welcome to 1370 41st Avenue, an inviting Spanish Mediterranean with bonus rooms and bath down nestled on a big lot in the coveted Outer Sunset, just blocks from Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, and the N Judah. This 1920s Classic welcomes visitors w/a bright & spacious FLR w/coved-ceilings, picture windows, wooden crown moldings & trim, a cozy Arts & Crafts fireplace, and custom built-ins. Adjacent is an FDR that flows seamlessly into an updated Chef's kitchen with an attractive breakfast area. A spacious primary suite nestled at the home's rear, a 2nd ample BD, and a 2nd modern BA complete the home's main living level. Fresh paint, warm hardwood floors, and recent updates, including a new roof, run throughout. Downstairs is a bonus finished studio with sliding door to the rear yard, and 3rd full bath. The property boasts a 120' deep lot that includes a big backyard ready for parties, pets, planting and play, and a spacious garage with laundry & storage.  Excellent central location, two blocks from GG Park, just minutes from Ocean Beach, top-rated Sunset schools, neighborhood shops & markets, and Muni lines for easy access to all points in San Francisco.
